item.content:encoded:
TLDR: Base has achieved Stage 1 Decentralization, a critical milestone in our journey to build an open and global onchain economy. We’ve done this by launching permissionless fault proofs and increasing the decentralization of our contract upgrade process with a security council. We believe that decentralization is critical to deliver on our mission of building a global onchain economy and are proud to have achieved this milestone.

What decentralization means for Base

Base’s mission is to build a global onchain economy that increases innovation, creativity, and freedom. We believe this is only possible on a decentralized platform. This is why Base is (1) built on Ethereum, the most secure and decentralized L1, (2) built on the open and permissionless OP Stack, and (3) upholds key Neutrality Principles.

We've been focused on continuously decentralizing, and today we're excited to announce that Base is now at Stage 1 Decentralization.

Achieving Stage 1 Decentralization means Base now has stronger security guarantees and reduced trust assumptions. With fault proofs and a decentralized Security Council in place, network functionality and upgrades are in the hands of a broad set of diverse stakeholders. This creates a more resilient foundation for apps, assets, and the global onchain economy on Base, so that:

  1. Builders have infrastructure certainty — the platform can't change the rules unexpectedly

  2. The network becomes more resilient, with no single point of failure

  3. Everyone can participate in securing and verifying the network

Decentralization stages

Vitalik Buterin's decentralization framework lays out a clear path for Layer-2 rollups on Ethereum, like Base, to progressively and safely decentralize. This framework describes three stages of decentralization:

  • Stage 0, or "full training wheels", is a stage where all rollup transactions are posted onchain, but the validity checks of these transactions are done by the chain's operator. State verification is centralized and dependent upon the chain operator.

  • Stage 1, or "limited training wheels", introduces a running fault proof or validity proof scheme with the practical authority to accept or reject state roots. It includes a decentralized override mechanism controlled by a diverse set of stakeholders, reducing dependence on chain operators alone.

  • Stage 2, or "no training wheels", represents full decentralization, where no group of actors can, even unanimously, post a state root other than the output of the code (except in clearly defined bug scenarios).

How we got to Stage 1 decentralization

Our path to Stage 1 decentralization involved two key milestones:

1. Fault Proofs on Mainnet

In October 2024, we launched Fault Proofs on Base Mainnet after close collaboration with Optimism to bring the OP Stack Fault Proof System to Base. Fault Proofs enable:

  • Permissionless proposals: Anyone can propose claims about the state of Base, removing reliance on a central party for state verification.

  • Permissionless challenges: If a faulty or fraudulent claim is made, anyone can challenge it within 3.5 days by running the open-source challenger software, with economic incentives for successful challenges.

This dramatically increased the decentralization of Base by allowing anyone to permissionlessly withdraw their funds from Base L2 to Ethereum L1 without relying on centralized actors.

2. Decentralizing upgrades via a Security Council

The final requirement to achieve Stage 1 Decentralization was to further decentralize control of contract upgrades. To do this, Base contract upgrades must now be approved by a diverse group of stakeholders from across the Ethereum ecosystem.

The Security Council for Base consists of 10 independent entities from various jurisdictions. To achieve consensus, the Security Council, Optimism, and Base collectively must reach at least a 75% approval threshold to implement a Base upgrade. This setup ensures that no single entity has enough power to control the upgrade process on its own. As a result, the group responsible for implementing upgrades, which currently includes Base and Optimism, is larger and more decentralized.

What’s next?

While reaching Stage 1 Decentralization is a significant achievement, our journey toward full decentralization continues. Looking ahead, we're focused on:

  • Additional proof systems — We're working towards having multiple active proof systems live on Base, to further enhance security and decentralization. A promising avenue we are exploring is ZK-based fault proof systems.

  • Advancing toward Stage 2 — We’re committed to further decentralizing and achieving Stage 2. We will continue taking steps toward that goal, including enabling the Security Council to provably detect and adjudicate bugs via the multi-proof system.

Today's achievement of Stage 1 Decentralization fulfills one of our key strategic pillars for 2025: "Base is for everyone." By decentralizing Base, we're building the foundation needed to bring everyone, everywhere onchain and creating a truly global economy that increases innovation, creativity, and freedom.

We're excited to continue building on the Base and Ethereum vision of a more open, decentralized, global onchain economy that is accessible to all.

Follow us on X, Farcaster, and join our Discord to get building — and follow the Base team and Base community leaders to stay up to date.

item.content:encoded:
TLDR: We’re introducing new building blocks that make it faster, simpler, and more powerful to build on Base: Flashblocks, Smart Wallet Sub Accounts, and Base Appchains — plus a new home base for builders.

Base is building for the long-term

Base’s mission is to build a global onchain economy that increases innovation, creativity, and freedom. To further our mission, we need to continue making Base more powerful, easier to use, and faster than ever. We are focused on cultivating an ecosystem of long-term people playing long-term games. We want to support passionate builders who are creating products that solve real needs for real people.

Today, we’re introducing three new building blocks to empower everyone to build onchain: Flashblocks to make Base faster, Base Appchains to help Base scale, and Smart Wallet Sub Accounts to make Base simpler to use.

  • Making Base faster: Flashblocks make Base 10x faster by bringing effective block times from 2 seconds to 200 milliseconds; the fastest EVM chain to date. We’re inviting builders to start testing Flashblocks on Base Sepolia testnet today.

  • Making Base more powerful: Base Appchains are Layer-3 chains on Base to help apps scale through dedicated blockspace, powered by the op-enclave framework. Appchains are a natural evolution for apps spending significant amounts on gas credits for their end users.

  • Making Base simpler: Smart Wallet Sub Accounts are now live on Base testnet — simplifying the UX on Base by reducing wallet pop-ups, improving security, and removing the need to manually manage different onchain accounts.

Base is fast: Flashblocks are now live on testnet

People expect near-instant responses when interacting with apps, and a snappy user experience is key to enabling the global onchain economy.

With Flashblocks, a technology built by Flashbots, Base chain will have 200-millisecond “preconfirmation blocks”. This will make Base 10x faster than it is today, and the fastest EVM chain to date.

Flashblocks are partial blocks issued by the block builder and streamed to nodes every 200 milliseconds, allowing users to experience early confirmation times with native revert protection. This architecture draws inspiration from innovations in block propagation and execution — such as Solana’s shreds and Celestia's data squares — while introducing novel optimizations for the rollup context. Learn more about how Flashblocks work in Flashbots’ documentation.

Flashblocks are now live on Base Sepolia testnet, with a path to mainnet in Q2. See the demo and start building with Flashblocks today.

Base is powerful: Base Appchains are now live

Base Appchains are Layer-3 chains that provide dedicated blockspace for apps looking to scale further on Base. High traffic, mature apps can take advantage of dedicated infrastructure powered by Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP). Apps that are spending significant funds sponsoring gas (such as with CDP Paymaster) should consider launching an Appchain for a more customized experience to meet demand.

Base Appchains are:

  • Built for scale: Using op-enclave, chain state is proven immediately using AWS S3 and AWS Nitro Enclaves. More technical details on how and why we built this can be found in our Engineering Blog. Each Appchain is supported by enterprise-grade infra, with a fully managed sequencer and nodes, maintenance and upgrades, and a ready-made block explorer.

  • Customizable: Appchains offer a series of customization options, including custom gas tokens, permission allowlists, and custom fee logic.

  • Builder-friendly: Appchains are managed through CDP with builder-friendly pricing and compatibility with Base builder tools like Smart Wallet and CDP Paymaster.

Blocklords, Super Champs, and Metacade are launching Appchains to meet the high demands of onchain gamers. Proof 8 and MVL offer real-world services that must operate at the scale Base Appchains are prepared to deliver. Decentralized Pictures is launching an Appchain on Base because of the throughput and scalability needed to distribute onchain cinematic art. Horizen’s Base Appchain will support real-world privacy applications, benefitting from Appchain programmability.

Base is simple: Smart Wallet Sub Accounts are now live on testnet

Over the past year, embedded app wallets have become popular because of their ease of use. However, they can also lead to disjointed experiences — forcing users to juggle multiple accounts, fund each separately, and keep track of assets spread across different accounts.

Smart Wallet Sub Accounts significantly improve UX for end users and DevX for builders. With fine-grained spend limits and the benefits of a single universal account, we are moving closer to a world where onchain apps “just work”. With Smart Wallet Sub Accounts:

  • Users can manage all of their onchain accounts from one universal wallet, removing the need to manually manage assets across multiple apps.

  • Users encounter less friction, with fewer signatures, fewer pop-ups, and a streamlined onchain experience.

  • Users can securely fund new accounts directly from their universal wallet with spend permissions, helping solve the cold start problem for builders.

Smart Wallet Sub Accounts are powered by our new underlying accounts framework — combining spend permissions, hierarchical account ownership, and a new ERC developed by the Base team.

Smart Wallet Sub Accounts are ready for integration on Base testnet today, and will be live on mainnet in Q2.

Read our engineering blog to dive into the technical details of Sub Accounts.

Base is for builders

Since day one, Base’s goal has been to empower builders with the tools to create world-class onchain apps. With these new building blocks, we’re making Base faster, simpler, and more powerful than ever before.

And to bring it all together, we launched a new hub — featuring tools, guides, stories, and more — to serve as the home base for builders creating the onchain future:

  • A new website with everything you need to build, scale, and monetize your onchain app. Start building today at base.org/builders.

  • A new social handle to keep you in the loop on everything that’s happening in the Base builder community. Follow @buildonbase.

  • A new GitHub for our open-source codebase, for those ready to roll up their sleeves and contribute directly to Base. Get involved at github.com/base.

What will you build?

TLDR: Coinbase Wallet has integrated Onboard P2P as an onramp option to make buying crypto easier around the world. Onboard lets anyone purchase crypto with local currency through a peer-to-peer exchange, without lengthy verification, and lower fees.

Coinbase Wallet and Base are committed to building a global onchain economy that increases innovation, creativity, and freedom. To achieve this mission, we need to make getting onchain as easy as possible – in every country in the world. However, a common barrier in many countries is being able to purchase crypto with local currency. Verification processes can be long and conversion rates lead to high fees.

To solve this, Coinbase Wallet is integrating with Onboard, a global peer-to-peer cryptocurrency exchange. With Onboard P2P, Coinbase Wallet users can purchase crypto using local currency from a network of seller merchants in as little as 5 minutes, with no need for ID verification if you buy under $100 USD in total.

How Onboard Works

Onboard operates a decentralized peer-to-peer exchange protocol that connects local buyers and sellers of cryptocurrency in different markets. The process works like this:

  • Buyers select the cryptocurrency and amount

  • Onboard matches the buyer to a seller in their region

  • An escrow is set up to facilitate a secure trade for both parties.

  • Once funds are confirmed, the cryptocurrency is released to the buyer

If you’re in Nigeria, try out the Onboard experience in Coinbase Wallet today. Simply select Pay with Onboard P2P when buying crypto. You’ll be directed to a simple and secure experience with Onboard, where you can select local payment options and be connected to a seller. Once payment is made, you’ll receive your crypto in as little as 5 minutes.

Expansion to More Countries in 2025

Nigeria is the first of many countries where Coinbase Wallet is offering easier access to Onboard’s peer-to-peer exchange. Onboard is aiming to enable its payment option in over 50 countries in the coming year, with Argentina, India, Indonesia, Kenya, the Philippines, and Turkey support coming soon. Contact Onboard if you’d like to be a merchant in these countries.

TLDR: To bring the world onchain, we’re rebuilding the Coinbase Wallet app to be 10x faster and easier to use, plus boosting app discovery by leveraging Farcaster Frames and their onchain social graph.

https://x.com/CoinbaseWallet/status/1886822569334181966

Last year, we made great progress with Coinbase Wallet by simplifying onboarding and transactions with Smart Wallet, building more options to buy crypto in over 140 countries, and rewarding people who bring their money onchain. We also announced that Coinbase Wallet and Base would join forces to help power the onchain flywheel.

Base supports developers who build onchain, Coinbase Wallet onboards people, and those people discover and experience great apps. This is the way the flywheel should work. But, the reality is that it’s not working as well as it should today.

We’re seeing all-time highs in downloads for Coinbase Wallet, but these people come onchain to buy a coin, and then stop there. Our goal is to take them further.

That’s what 2025 is all about — doing more than just getting people through the door by connecting them to the incredible products that builders are creating every day. It’s about helping builders go viral with their products, coins, and creativity.

To do this, we’re building the next evolution of Coinbase Wallet.

Coinbase Wallet’s big rocks for 2025

We’re rebuilding Coinbase Wallet into an open platform that anyone can build and grow into, and we’re going to help builders go viral. To do this, we’re focusing on:

  • Helping apps get discovered. We’re adding a social graph to the Coinbase Wallet app by leveraging Farcaster, an open, social protocol that anyone can build on top of. We’ll use Farcaster to power a full social feed, as well as mini-apps with Frames v2. These are bite-sized onchain experiences — created in minutes — allowing users to take actions without leaving the feed.

  • Making Coinbase Wallet 10x faster and easier to use. We’re rewriting everything from the ground up. We started this late last year, have made incredible progress, and will be rolling out the first beta in the coming months.

  • Evolving our brand to represent more than Coinbase Wallet and Base.  Since 2023, we’ve seen an explosion of creativity from the community and feel that we need a brand that not only represents us, but something that the community can use and own themselves. It takes everyone working together to build a better internet.

Here’s what’s changing

As we work to carry out this vision, we’re excited about what this means for the onchain economy.

  • First, we’re going to make Coinbase Wallet work incredibly well for payments. Crypto payments are a core use case and a key foundation for everything else, and today they’re still too hard. 2025 is the year we make payments just work.

  • For builders, we’re going to help them reach millions of users coming onchain with mini-apps supported across the social feed. It’ll be the easiest way to get distribution and go viral.

  • For traders, we’re going to accelerate the onchain network that makes viral token moments happen. We’re building a wallet that lets you follow, trade, and share with your social network, all in one place.

  • For creators, we’re going to help you connect and earn from your creativity, with millions of people ready to join your community.

  • And for everyone onchain, we’re going to make it incredibly easy for you to find the apps you want to use, the coins you want to buy, the projects you love, and the communities you want to be a part of.

2025 will be the year Coinbase Wallet becomes the place for distribution for builders, creators, and communities. We have a lot to do, and we can’t do this alone.

Want to be a part of it? Start bringing your content onchain, and start experimenting with mini-apps that can be part of the onchain social graph. The more people we have building on top of open standards like Farcaster, the faster we bring the world onchain.

Join us on Farcaster and X as we share how all this will unfold, and to be a part of the new beta experience soon.

TLDR: Base is a global onchain economy and we’re building it together, in the open. This year, we’re focusing on growing the Base economy by investing in five key pillars: builders, apps, ownership, markets, and bringing everyone, everywhere, onchain. We have a plan — but we can only achieve our ambitious goals by building with all of you. As we collaborate and grow, our strategies will continue to evolve to better serve the Base economy.

Our mission

Our mission is to build a global onchain economy that increases innovation, creativity, and freedom. A new internet, built by the people, for the people.

Success looks like the whole world onchain — millions of builders and billions of people — and the only way we get there is by connecting people, builders, and businesses. By inviting the world to build alongside us and building in the open, we’re creating a new kind of internet that supports an open, thriving economy for everyone.

One of the biggest pieces of feedback we consistently hear is that it’s still too hard to join this new economy. This year, we’re focused on simplifying the message, making the products just work, and bringing the whole world onchain.

Our big, hairy, audacious goals for 2025

To bring a billion people onchain, we have to work hard and push ourselves beyond our comfort zones. If we’re hitting every milestone we set, we’re not aiming high enough. So, as we enter 2025, we set some big, hairy, audacious goals that both excite and scare us:

  • 25 million people

  • 25 thousand developers

  • 250 Mgas/s blockspace capacity

  • $100 billion assets on platform

  • 1 billion transactions on Base in October

When we look back at the end of this year, we’ll know we’re on track if we reached for these goals and they challenged us to go above and beyond. With a bit of luck and a lot of determination, we have a shot at achieving them.

Our five strategic pillars for 2025

To achieve these goals, in 2025, we need to work together. And that means focusing our collective efforts on things that accelerate each other and help us be stronger, together. To help keep us all rowing in the same direction, we want to pull back the curtain and share what the Base core team is doing to make it happen. Our hope is that this inspires you to build with us.

#1 Base is for builders

We will build powerful and open tools that enable anyone to build world-class onchain apps. Whether you’re an advanced onchain developer, a web2 convert, or a total beginner, we want to enable you to build and make an impact.

  1. Double down on OnchainKit and the building blocks for world-class apps

  2. Ship new tools to help builders embrace AI agents and mini-apps

  3. Enable gasless experiences and scale with Paymasters and L3s

#2 Base is for apps

We will nurture a vibrant ecosystem of connected, open onchain apps that grow the number of people using Base. More apps translate to more concrete reasons for every single person to get onchain.

  1. Help apps, builders, and creators go viral by giving them more distribution

  2. Build new tools to help creators earn more, tell the story of onchain, and grow

  3. Make core onchain experiences across social, trading, payments, and messaging

#3 Base is for ownership

We will create a powerful onchain account with seamless funding, identity, and management. We’ll continue our work on Smart Wallet to eliminate complexity for developers and users, make apps just work, and put control back in your hands.

  1. New user onboarding in <60s (with funding!) without creating siloed accounts

  2. Make apps just work without popups or compromising user sovereignty

  3. Enable users to easily leverage their full identity and assets in a secure, private way

#4 Base is for markets

We will make Base the center of the onchain economy with highly liquid, always-on, global capital markets. The more assets and liquidity we bring to Base, the faster the entire financial world will come onchain.

  1. Bring Coinbase onchain and grow the number of assets on Base

  2. Support 25+ local currency stablecoins to enable every country to come onchain

  3. Enable on and offramps in every country around the world

#5 Base is for everyone

We will decentralize, scale, and accelerate Base to enable everyone, everywhere to come onchain. The only way we can build a truly global economy is by making sure it’s built on a decentralized, open platform — and we are proud to do this as part of Ethereum and the Superchain.

  1. Achieve Stage 1 decentralization

  2. Scale Base’s blockspace capacity to 250 Mgas/s

  3. Speed up blocktimes and drive down fees to deliver <1s, <1¢ transactions

These five strategic pillars are what the Base team is focused on today — and we’re building and learning every day. As we do, we’ll continue to evolve our plans and together we’ll bring the world onchain.

How we build in a based way

At the end of the day, it’s not just about what we do in 2025 — it’s also about how we do it. And in 2025, we’re going to stay based. This means:

  1. Doing the right thing

  2. Working hard

  3. Staying optimistic

  4. Pushing boundaries with creativity

  5. Putting the team over the individual

If all of us can build in a based way, we’ll be able to go faster and further.

The rest is up to us

We’ve shared the Base mission and strategy and how the Base core team is contributing to make it happen. But at the end of the day, we can only succeed if all Base builders step up to make it happen. We win, together.

Are you ready to build alongside us?

Join us on X, Farcaster, and Discord to get building — and follow the Base team and Base community leaders to stay up to day with the Base economy as it grows.

TLDR: Base just wrapped up our first world tour. We traveled to Kenya, India, Thailand, Singapore, and the Philippines. We met over 1,000 builders, selected 50+ buildathon winners, and hosted 11 events. We’re so excited to keep working alongside our global builder community in 2025.

Builders are creating the onchain future, around the world

With Base Around the World, we saw firsthand the real-world power of onchain tools in action, and met with incredible builders who are shaping the vision of a global onchain economy.

Here’s what we learned:

  1. Momentum is global. Builders around the world are pushing the limits, and we’re here to invest in their futures. In 2025, we're doubling down on global initiatives, offering more resources, support, and office hours across time zones. We're also hiring country leads for Kenya, Argentina, and the Philippines to ensure local support is as strong as it can be. If you or someone else could be a fit, apply here.

  2. Stablecoins are key. To build a global onchain economy, stablecoins are a must. They power critical use cases, from cross-border remittances to local merchant payments to small business payroll. In 2025, we believe Base’s position as the leading L2 makes it uniquely positioned as the premier onchain destination for stablecoins.

  3. Local solutions, global impact. Every region has its unique challenges, but there are common themes: control over financial lives, better access to credit, and fairer economics for creators. Builders can solve these problems locally and have a global impact.

Shout-out to our community builders and Buildathon participants

Africa (Kenya)

Our first IRL stop was Kenya, where we met builders tackling social and financial challenges.  We were inspired by grassroots heroes like Maeve, who translated Base docs to Swahili.  Builders like Yele, Njoku, and Elijah passionately and generously support, elevate and mentor builders across Africa. We heard from many builders working to improve cross-border payments, IRL and P2P commerce, and microlending, all through onchain solutions.

Based Africa buildathon had the highest number of projects submitted, and we’re proud to announce 23 winners: Base Sessions, Basepay, The Unbound Project, Flexclub, RideBase, Azza Defi, AfroBase, Lendbit, Delar, Kombat, Yield, learnOnchain, Legitify, Antugrow, Health Trove, baseEastAfrica, Maisha Care, MQR Pay, PayFlip, Base Tours, Data Bud, LearNova, and Element Pay.

We’re super grateful for the builders bringing Africa onchain, including Yele, Yoseph, Dami, Kokocodes, Charis, Harriet, Grammy Boy, JBofLagos, Bernard, DefiDevrel, Miss Purple, Kokkytau, Druxamb, KC Pele, Njoku, David Lumala, Roger, Kago, Chris, and countless others. We had so much fun meeting some of them in person. Check out our conversations with DefiDevrel and HazardKrypto.

Base is committed to Africa’s long-term growth, and we’re starting by hiring a Country Lead in Kenya to help build stronger local support. We can’t wait to meet more of you and continue the journey.

India (Bangalore)

After Kenya, our next stop was Bangalore. We connected with hundreds of builders and participated in an IRL/onchain soccer tournament. Indian builders are laser-focused on building solutions for global audiences . Big shout-out to our Based India buildathon winners, including: Based Coffee, Tike, Basics, SuperBaseNames, DefiLens, TagFi, CultureCo, CastMoney, EtherZap, Lumen, Vox, MiniBase, and Neom.

We’re grateful to all builders who contributed to the Based India buildathon and who are bringing people onchain every day:, Akhil, Sankalp, Denver and the entire Devfolio team, Apoorav, Ashik, Cyber Shakti, Harpreet, Kushal, Pareen, Shubham, Mohit, Tushar, Vraj, Gayatri, and many more.

If you’re a builder in India, and want to stay connected with the builder community, follow Based India, reach out to Saumya (India Country Lead),  and watch this epic recap of our meetup.

Southeast Asia (Bangkok, Singapore, Johor Bahru, and Manila)

After Bangalore, we landed in Bangkok for Devcon and announced the Based SEA winners during our Bangkok Meetup. We opened up Home Base for Devcon, had an incredible breakfast with women+ building on Base, and Jesse Pollak participated in a panel with Vitalik, sharing how Base now passes the walk-away test. Following Devcon, we had meetups in Singapore and closed the tour in Manila, where we participated in the YGG Gaming Summit and announced the launch of Onchain Guilds. We also made a quick stop to visit Balaji and the builders at the Network School.

We can't wait to see more creativity and new use cases come out of SEA. Check out our Based SEA buildathon winners: Cube, AgroFund, Based Chula Students, AutoBase, Onchain Buster, Magnify Cash, StreamFund, Local Coins, Kaivest, Onchain Scholars, WhiteBlue Swap, and Coinbase Smart Passport.

We’re also grateful for the builders who made Based SEA a success, including santosa, 0xwildanr, Atomo, ayvee, aho, Harry, hypersound, Jitz (thanks for your awesome recap vid), kangun, kylepatrick, Nine, PShato, reallyryl, Pm, el, drizz, nael, and many others.

If you’re a builder based in Southeast Asia and want to get involved, follow Based SEA on X and Warpcast.

LatAm (Argentina, virtual)

Although we couldn’t make it to Argentina in person, we’re excited to visit for a full LatAm tour in 2025. Thanks to the Based LatAm community (powered by Odisea) for hosting the virtual buildathon and making it a success.

We’re grateful to cush, Max, chaps, Fer, Juampi, João, Simoneth, Solange, Robert, sweetman, Losi, Carlos, and many more for making the Based Latam buildathon a success and bringing people onchain to Base.

We were excited to see projects across diverse use cases in LatAm, from stablecoins to access to credit and more. Check them out: CrediTalent, Bondi Finance, CLPD Stablecoin, BOBC Stablecoin, BuildMyEvent, Sembrando El Cambio, OpenVino, and AI Agent for Coinbase Wallet.

What’s next

Across the globe, builders have told us they want continuous support — and we’re listening. In 2025 we’re planning to:

  • Mentorship and education: We’re launching office hours in Africa, India, and SEA time zones to provide faster support. Plus, we’ve teamed up with RareSkills to offer an intermediate smart contract development bootcamp focused on token standards.

  • Hiring: We’re looking for country leads in Kenya, the Philippines, and Argentina, along with more global roles in dev rel, marketing, and engineering. We will continue to grow our country coverage to ensure all builders get the support they need. Check out open positions here.

  • Product updates: Stablecoins remain a priority in 2025. Base believes its position as the leading L2 makes it uniquely positioned as the premier onchain destination for stablecoins.. We’re also rolling out new product features to make it even easier to get onchain.

The Base Around the World tour was a journey we’ll never forget, and we’re excited for what’s ahead. Builders, we’ll see you in 2025.
